reason: E1 and E3 show that dislocation nucleation/drag and positive strain-rate sensitivity occur in other HEAs, but none of the cited evidence directly addresses the Co-free FeNiCrMn system or confirms that low temperature suppresses twinning in this specific alloy. The premises are thus only partly supported by the cited studies.
premises: Dislocation nucleation and drag increase strain rate sensitivity in related HEAs
Yield strength increases with strain rate in dynamic loading of HEAs
Dislocation density and arrangement can be quantified by TEM/EBSD
Low temperature suppresses twinning in FCC HEAs
